answer_text:
Here's a summary of the maximum unemployment benefits you can collect in **Massachusetts** in 2026:

### 💰 Maximum Weekly Benefit Amount
Your weekly benefit amount will be about **50% of your average weekly wage**, up to a maximum of **$1,105 per week** (as of October 5, 2025).

### 👶 Dependency Allowance
If you have dependents and you are their main support, you may be eligible for a **dependency allowance of up to $25 per child**. Spouses are not included.

### 📅 Maximum Duration
The **maximum duration of benefits is 30 weeks** in Massachusetts. Under normal conditions, the duration is **26 weeks**.

### 💵 Maximum Total Payout
The total maximum payout — combining the weekly rate with the maximum duration — is approximately **$33,150** (30 weeks × $1,105).

### 📊 How It Compares
Massachusetts is one of the most generous states in the country, with a maximum of **$1,105/week with dependents** and **$823/week without dependents.**

### 🧾 Taxes
Unemployment benefits are taxable for both **federal and Massachusetts state income tax**. You can elect to have **10% withheld for federal taxes** and **5% withheld for Massachusetts state taxes**.

You can apply and get more details at **mass.gov** through the Department of Unemployment Assistance (DUA).
